name: IPC-6012 performance class: annular ring and plating
notes: IPC-6012 is an acceptance standard for the finished board. Class 3 requires at least 50 um external and 25 um internal annular ring after fabrication; Class 2 allows up to 90 degrees breakout, Class 1 up to 180 degrees.

A design needs extra ring for the fab's drill-to-pad registration: the design limits are the acceptance values plus 'registration_mm' (default 0.075 mm, the hole-position tolerance JLCPCB and PCBWay publish). Set tech.context.registration_mm for your fab.
Class 1 and 2 limits here are conservative (no breakout at worst-case registration). Hole plating (20 um Class 1/2, 25 um Class 3 average) cannot be checked in the design: put the class on the order.
Only the ring and plating parts of IPC-6012 are encoded. Reproduced from a secondary source; check against your copy of the standard.

registration_mm.description: drill-to-pad registration tolerance of the fab (mm)

ring.note: 180 degree breakout allowed: the hole must only stay inside its pad
90 degree breakout allowed; ring covers the drill registration

ring_outer.note: 50 um external ring after fabrication + registration

ring_inner.note: 25 um internal ring after fabrication + registration
